label: Accessible name of the group of a plugin's settings, which save as they change.
undo: Button that takes back the last saved change to the settings.
redo: Button that saves again a change Undo took back.
footnote: Small print under the settings. Undo and Redo are the buttons' names.
save-failed: Error when the settings could not be saved, without a reason from the server.
apply-failed: Error when the settings were saved but the plugin's service could not restart with them.
apply.pending: Status beside the save status: the plugin's service restarts with the saved settings shortly.
apply.applying: Status: the service is restarting with the settings.
apply.applied: Status: the service runs with the saved settings.
apply.failed: Status: the service doesn't have the saved settings yet.
apply.now: Link-styled button that gives the service the saved settings at once.
field.default-choice: First choice of a setting's list: leave it empty and use its default. {{value}} is the default, as the plugin wrote it.
field.not-set: First choice of a setting's list when it has no default: leave it empty.
field.choose: Disabled first choice of a required list with no value yet.
field.not-a-choice: A saved value that the setting's list no longer offers. {{value}} is that value.
field.default: After a setting's description: its default value. <code> wraps {{value}}, the value as the plugin wrote it, in code style.
field.required: After a setting's description: it must be set.
